purpose.value: This procedure standardizes intake of customer card-dispute notices before an investigator reviews them.

value: Record the merchant, amount, posting date, customer recognition statement, and available receipt. Create a review item and route it to Card Disputes. Do not promise reimbursement.
If the customer also reports unrecognized transactions, pause ordinary intake and escalate for possible fraud review.

purpose.value: This procedure governs initial handling of customer card-dispute notices and preserves the human decision boundary.

value: Capture merchant, amount, posting date, whether the merchant is recognized, and supporting-document availability.
Create a review item, redact identifiers from free-text notes, and route to Card Disputes.
A human investigator decides any outcome.
Messages containing both recognized and unrecognized transactions must be escalated rather than automatically routed.

purpose.value: The procedure explains how staff record a reported lost physical card.

value: Confirm the customer through approved authentication
mark the card for specialist review
record the last known possession date
offer transfer to the replacement-card team
If unauthorized transactions are also reported, open a fraud-review item and do not state that the customer will be reimbursed.

purpose.value: The procedure sets the collection period for merchant documentation.

value: Staff to request supporting documents within five calendar days of intake and record the request.

purpose.value: This procedure standardizes neutral acknowledgement of formal service complaints.

value: Record the complaint category, acknowledge receipt, and send the item to a human complaint owner. Do not promise a resolution date that has not been approved.
Threats of immediate physical harm follow the emergency escalation procedure.

purpose.value: This procedure covers customer-requested mailing-address changes.

value: Authenticate the customer, capture the new address, repeat it for confirmation, and create an auditable change record.
A request paired with suspicious account-access activity must be escalated before the address is changed.

purpose.value: This procedure routes general lending inquiries without making credit decisions.

value: Record the product of interest and preferred contact channel, then refer the inquiry to a licensed lending specialist. Staff must not quote an approval probability.
Existing-loan servicing disputes follow the loan-servicing procedure rather than this referral procedure.
One current government photo identification document is sufficient for every review.

purpose.value: This procedure handles reports of a recognized merchant posting the same payment more than once.

value: Capture both transaction identifiers, amount, merchant, and receipt availability.
Route the item for human dispute review and send only a neutral acknowledgement.
Unrecognized duplicates are escalated for fraud triage.

purpose.value: This procedure records complaints involving accessibility accommodations.

value: Capture the requested accommodation, interaction channel, and service impact.
Route the complaint to a human accessibility specialist.
Immediate safety concerns use emergency escalation.
